prompt: Create a dramatic cinematic historical collage of Ludwig van Beethoven seated in profile at an old wooden piano, playing with both hands while looking downward in grief and concentration. The scene is a wide 16:9 composition with the composer occupying the left-center, wearing a dark early-19th-century coat, white shirt collar, and black cravat, with wild gray-brown curly hair and a weathered face lit by warm side light. Use a fractured mixed-media aesthetic: torn parchment, cracked glass shards, diagonal black-and-red abstract slashes, dust, scratches, and layered fragments of handwritten sheet music surrounding him. Include exactly 1 grand/fortepiano-like keyboard instrument in the foreground, exactly 1 violin resting on top of the piano, exactly 1 lit candle on the far right, exactly 1 distant classical cathedral or monumental building fragment on the left, and exactly 1 serene golden landscape visible through foliage on the right, with a river or lake winding between mountains under hazy sunlight. The mood should contrast collapse and serenity: dark, chaotic, and blood-red on the left; warm, green, and peaceful on the right. Add leafy branches around the right edge and music manuscript fragments floating across the entire image. No readable modern text, no watermark, no logo. Render in ultra-detailed photorealistic digital art with painterly texture, high contrast chiaroscuro, sepia-gold grading, cinematic lighting, dramatic atmosphere, and a tragic Romantic-era tone inspired by late Beethoven sonata melancholy.

promptZh: 创作一幅极具戏剧性的电影感历史拼贴画，主角为 路德维希·凡·贝多芬，他侧身坐在古老的木制钢琴前，双手弹奏，低头沉浸在悲伤与专注之中。画面采用 16:9 宽画幅构图，作曲家位于左中位置，身穿 19 世纪初的深色外套，配有白色衬衫领和黑色领结，灰棕色的卷发凌乱，饱经风霜的脸庞被温暖的侧光照亮。采用破碎的混合媒介美学：撕裂的羊皮纸、破碎的玻璃碎片、对角线的黑红抽象斜线、灰尘、划痕以及围绕在他身边的层叠手写乐谱碎片。前景中包含 1 台大钢琴/古钢琴，钢琴上放置 1 把小提琴，最右侧有 1 支点燃的蜡烛，左侧有 1 处遥远的古典大教堂或纪念性建筑碎片，右侧透过叶丛可见 1 片宁静的金色风景，河流或湖泊在朦胧阳光下的山峦间蜿蜒。氛围应呈现崩溃与宁静的对比：左侧阴暗、混乱且带有血红色；右侧温暖、翠绿且祥和。在右侧边缘添加枝叶，让乐谱碎片漂浮在整个画面中。画面中不得出现可辨认的现代文字、水印或 Logo。采用超精细的写实数字艺术渲染，具有绘画质感、高对比度的明暗对照法、深褐色与金色的色调分级、电影级灯光、戏剧性氛围，以及受 贝多芬晚期奏鸣曲忧郁感 启发的浪漫主义悲剧基调。
